findings.issue: The full-bleed rose mat overflows the document horizontally by half the scrollbar width on every browser with classic (space-consuming) scrollbars. `right-[calc(50%-50vw)]` measures 50vw against the viewport INCLUDING the scrollbar, while the 50% is of the 1152px container centred in (viewport − scrollbar). Panel right edge = documentWidth + scrollbar/2 ≈ +7.5px, at every width ≥1024. Result is a horizontal scrollbar on the desktop view. Fix: `overflow-x: clip` on the hero <section> (nothing inside it is sticky/fixed), or bleed with a negative margin measured off the container instead of vw.
findings.where: hero mat, src/app/(me)/demo/studio-ljepote-mila/page.tsx:230-233 (`right-[calc(50%-50vw)]`); no overflow guard exists in src/app/globals.css
findings.evidence: Not visible in the AFTER shots — headless full-page captures render no scrollbar, which is why the fixer's 'zero horizontal overflow at 1440/1920' check is a false negative. Derived from the CSS: container = min(1152, W), left = (W−1152)/2, right offset = 576 − viewport/2, so panel right = W + scrollbarWidth/2. This is the only 50vw in the repo, so no other demo carries the guard either.

findings.issue: ~298px of empty porcelain in the hero's left rail between the CTA row and the pinned foot line — the first screen's largest void, and larger than the 230px void change #3 was written to remove. The rail carries kicker + 2-line h1 + 1-line deck + CTA row (≈336px) but is stretched to the photograph's 672px, so the only thing in its bottom half is one 10px caps line. Either shorten the panel/photo (h-[32rem]) so the columns are nearer in height, or drop lg:self-stretch and set the foot line at a fixed offset under the CTA.

overall: Real, substantial progress: a full screen of void is deleted, the conversion is genuinely inverted, the kicker count is down from five to two, the treatment grid is now a type-locked per-item map with no empty cell at any of the three widths, the masthead holds its cover status at 390px, and the signature is a legitimate density peak. The one measured container break (the print hanging 64px proud of the rose panel's bottom) is exactly the move the plan asked for and it reads at 1440. Two things keep it just short of the best four: the hero's left rail still carries ~300px of first-screen void — the fix relocated the void rather than removing it — and the 50vw bleed introduces a genuine horizontal overflow on any browser with classic scrollbars, which the headless captures could not reveal. The copy contradiction about group size between the treatments index and the Edukacije band is cheap to fix but matters more than its size, because the data-layer honesty is this page's strongest claim.
